caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown, fluted baking mold shown from a slightly elevated angle. The mold is centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. It has a circular shape with a scalloped edge and a raised central cone. The color of the mold includes various shades of brown, with darker tones on the fluted outer edges and lighter, tan highlights on its interior surfaces, giving the object a metallic or ceramic appearance. There are no other objects, patterns, or details surrounding the mold, making it the only subject of the drawing. The artist's signature, "GOLDBERG," appears faintly in the lower left corner.
title: Turk's Head Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
